q: The stability of sofic entropy under extensions and factors: if π: (X,μ,G) → (Y,ν,G) is a G-equivariant factor map, then:
opts: hΣ(μ) ≥ hΣ(ν) (factors cannot have greater entropy)
Entropy is not preserved under factors for non-amenable groups
exp: For sofic entropy: factors cannot have greater entropy. hΣ(factor) ≤ hΣ(base action). This is the monotonicity of sofic entropy under factor maps, extending the classical fact h(factor) ≤ h(T) for KS entropy. Extensions can only increase entropy.
